source.body: {"steps":[{"type":"selectOne","var":"tank","sql":"SELECT tank_code FROM oc_tank WHERE tank_code = ?","params":["${input.tankCode}"]},{"type":"failIfNull","var":"tank","message":"Tank not found"},{"type":"selectOne","var":"vol","sql":"@file:oc_submitMeasurement-step.sql","params":["${input.levelCm}","${input.levelCm}","${input.tankCode}"]},{"type":"exec","sql":"@file:oc_submitMeasurement-step.sql","params":["${input.tankCode}","${input.measuredAt}","${input.levelCm}","${input.temperatureC}","${vol.volume_l}","${input.operatorName}","${input.lat}","${input.lon}","${input.note}"]},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","status":"accepted","volume_l":"${vol.volume_l}"}}]}
